# Herpetoverse

> Husbandry tracker for reptile and amphibian keepers on iOS, Android and the
> web. Keepers log feedings, sheds, weights and growth for each animal, plan
> breeding, track feeder stock, and read free species care sheets. Free for up
> to 5 animals. Published by Appalachian Tarantulas, LLC (Tennessee, USA).
> Sibling app for invertebrates: Tarantuverse.

## Who it is for
- Hobby keepers of snakes, lizards and geckos, turtles and tortoises, frogs,
  and salamanders and newts
- Breeders tracking pairings, clutches, incubation and offspring

## What it does
- Feeding logs, with refusals recorded as clearly as meals
- Feeding Day: every animal that is due in one list, logged in one pass;
  due dates follow species and life stage
- Weight history and growth trends, shed records (including retained sheds)
- Photos and notes for each animal, QR enclosure tags
- Breeding: pairings, clutches, incubation and offspring (Premium)
- Morph calculator for ball pythons and leopard geckos, including het and
  possible-het odds
- Feeder inventory for frozen stock and live colonies, with low-stock alerts
  (Premium)
- Sitter links (a care card per animal, no account needed) and co-keepers
  (shared collections, Premium to invite up to 10 people)
- Feeding reminders and a daily digest
- Collection import, and export of all data

## Species care sheets (free, no account needed)
- Index: https://herpetoverse.com/species
- Each sheet lives at https://herpetoverse.com/species/{slug}, for example
  https://herpetoverse.com/species/leopard-gecko and
  https://herpetoverse.com/species/ball-python
- Each sheet lists temperature zones, humidity, UVB, enclosure size by life
  stage, substrate, diet and prey size by life stage, feeding frequency,
  lifespan and conservation status, with the published sources it is based on.

## Pricing (USD, as listed at https://herpetoverse.com/pricing)
- Free: up to 5 animals, unlimited feeding, weight and shed logs, care sheets,
  Feeding Day, photos, import and export, reminders, 2 open sitter links
- Herpetoverse Premium: USD 4.99 per month, USD 44.99 per year, or USD 149.99
  once for lifetime. Adds unlimited animals, feeder inventory, breeding,
  co-keeper invites and sitter logging.
- All-Access: USD 6.99 per month, USD 69.99 per year, or USD 249 once.
  Premium on both Herpetoverse and Tarantuverse.
